profile_text.body:
Okta is a publicly traded identity security company founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, California (ticker: OKTA). The company describes itself as putting identity at the heart of business security and growth, offering two platforms, Okta and Auth0, that enable secure access, authentication, and automation for employees, customers, and what it calls non-human identities.

On the AI side, Okta offers a product called Okta AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI. It covers identity AI capabilities including risk-based authentication, privileged access, and identity threat detection. The company's site frames both platforms as extensible, supporting workforce, customer, and AI-related identity use cases.

The site holds 181 California law exposure entries associated with Okta, suggesting a notable volume of legal or regulatory activity recorded under California jurisdiction, though no specific litigation cases are detailed in the available data. Okta carries the SEC CIK number 0001660134, confirming its status as a reporting public company.
